answer: A workable design: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the vine to sunk effort, uses the beacon as an corroborating signal, then requires a haven before any payout.
